description: This file is a PHP source file defining the ListView for displaying groups in the SuiteCRM system. It initializes a ListView object, sets up headers and query parameters, and renders the list of groups.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering list views in the SuiteCRM application, manages headers, queries, and display of list data.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes the template used for rendering the list view, binding it to the specified HTML template and language strings.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the title displayed in the header of the list view.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Configures the query parameters for retrieving list data, including filters, ordering, and target module.

methods.name: show_mass_update
methods.description: Flag to enable or disable mass update feature in the list view.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Executes the process to gather data and render the list view based on the previous configurations.
